about: grid placement goes in declaration order from just after the previous child, leaving holes behind; a child spanning rows keeps those cells for later children; a spacer takes a cell like any child (its row 0 high when alone in it); hidden and false children take no cell while a zero-size one does; fields of another container or child kind, bad tracks, spans past the columns (also the { min } columns the width gives) and baseline in a grid or stack are refused (probe-confirmed by oracles s25 and s34)
